title: Entanglement assisted quantum $(r,δ)$-locally recoverable codes
summary: Quantum $(r,δ)$-locally recoverable codes are quantum error-correcting codes capable of correcting $δ-1$ qudit erasures within one subset of qudits of cardinality at most $r+δ-1$. In this paper, we introduce the more general framework of entanglement-assisted quantum $(r,δ)$-locally recoverable codes, assuming that the local recovery operation is assisted by receiver-held qudits that remain unaffected by erasures.
